company.name: Amyris
company.shortDescription: Amyris is a biotech company that creates chemical products using advanced fermentation processes derived from sugarcane.
company.description: Amyris Biotechnologies creates renewable products that focus on fuels and chemicals that provide no-compromise sustainable alternatives to a broad range of petroleum-sourced products. It uses an industrial synthetic biology platform that applies its innovative bioscience solutions to convert plant sugars into hydrocarbon molecules and produce specialty ingredients and consumer products. Its technology creates products that support biopharmaceutical drug discovery and production, from cosmetic emollients and fragrances to fuels, solvents, lubricants, and nutraceuticals.

aiResearchSummary.text: Amyris is engaged in developing olefinic feedstocks from terpenes, producing cannabinoids in genetically modified host cells, and creating sugarcane-derived semi-synthetic cosmetic ingredients. Their research includes methods for producing human milk oligosaccharides, retinol, canthaxanthin, myrcene, steviol glycosides, vanillin, and isoprenoid compounds using engineered microbial systems. These activities span fermentation-based production of specialty chemicals, bioactive compounds, and cosmetic ingredients.
